Instead been trying to model and encourage the practice throughout....maybe that is what I should do have us reflect on how we have grown as writers to this point

....that is what I am going to do.....Will share my stuff on writing an assessment. Its called TAG TEAM and truth it is part an ODE to Randy the Macho Man Savage...story for another time...
